purpose: Constructive sensitivity of source summaries to a bounded conditional interaction; synthetic probes only, no new real outcome validation
schedule: Complete scientific design, typed candidate validation, independent pre-execution review and all three candidate freezes
Freeze this protocol, complete analysis code, descriptive thresholds, task/inputs and candidate commitments before first source execution
Execute all three labels at all three source seeds in both source contexts; preserve failures, no reruns under reused identifiers
Release complete source execution and portfolio commitments for the fixed source screen
Stop before synthetic probe generation if any required source-screen or implementation check fails; no tolerance widening
If the screen passes, execute the full three-label by three-seed synthetic probe grid, commit all nine outputs, then release aggregate analysis
No scientific tuning after any new output; retain all results and limitations

numerical_source_screen.definition: For each alternative minus/plus, each of 46 checks and each same seed, absolute(check_alternative-check_zero) <= 3 times the historical s1_final generator_seed_draw_sd for that check
numerical_source_screen.zero_historical_sd: Require exact equality, not an invented epsilon
numerical_source_screen.threshold_source: M5 source-only s1_final portfolio at seeds 76101,76102,76103; freeze original report hash and all 46 thresholds before new runs
numerical_source_screen.meaning: Descriptive comparison on a previously observed simulation-noise scale; not statistical equivalence, source admissibility, paired standard error, coverage guarantee or clinical tolerance
numerical_source_screen.anchor: Zero retains the s1_final conditional law algebraically; all zero-to-paper discrepancies remain visible
numerical_source_screen.OLS_reported_CI: Report whether estimates fall in Oh [5.853,7.774] as a location diagnostic, not a calibrated acceptance test under approximate source populations
numerical_source_screen.semantic_audit: Report all20 Oh Table2 age/BMI/sex strata under both arithmetic and geometric interpretations, giving40 descriptive comparisons per draw. Neither interpretation is asserted as resolved. Three differently adjusted or paired estimands remain unassessed.

analytic_requirements.pairwise_invariance: Source age-TG and BMI-TG laws unchanged in the declared product source population via separately centered compact age and BMI contrasts and an integral-zero outcome density contrast
analytic_requirements.positivity: Independent certificate using analytic extrema of reference mean and density over active support; no grid-only lower-bound claim
analytic_requirements.centering: Validate contrasts against the declared source marginal counts; quantify non-product departure of the finite independently permuted context
analytic_requirements.sampler: Paired inverse-CDF map; monotonicity from strict positivity; 40 bisection steps on [70,190], bound120/2^40 mg/dL
analytic_requirements.exact_row_invariants: Female rows, rows outside the active covariate support and rows whose common baseline TG is outside (70,190) remain unchanged; source threshold indicators at200 and500 remain unchanged

probe.type: Synthetic Cartesian grid, not a human cohort or a representative target distribution
probe.materiality_rule: MAX absolute plus-minus conditional-mean gap over the four fixed cells >=5 mg/dL; report every cell and its individual >=5 flag
probe.materiality_boundary: Pre-run constructive-design threshold, not clinical importance or an empirical discovery. Builder algebra predicts approximately3.37,4.82,6.93,9.91 mg/dL before execution.
probe.empirical_blocks: Male age35..44 or55..64 crossed with BMI22..23 or26..27; all four blocks reported with same-seed paired differences
probe.regressions: Unweighted descriptive point estimates on the synthetic grid: logTG~1+A+B+F for age/BMI/sex; addB^2 and report2bQ; rawTG same quadratic contrast; addB*F for BMI-sex interaction; addA*B for age-BMI interaction. A=(age-50)/10,B=(BMI-25)/5,F=1 iffemale.
probe.uncertainty: Simulation ranges only; no real reference, clinical confidence intervals or sampling-population inference

interpretation: A passing construction shows ambiguity conditional on the stated source reconstruction and imperfect anchor; it does not show that both laws fit all published evidence
Unimplemented or ambiguous evidence remains evidence, not a license to choose arbitrary relationships
The deliberate conditional interaction is not a newly discovered biological mechanism
A failed numerical screen or insufficient separation ends this attempt; it does not establish uniqueness
Prior NHANES results were unavailable to the fresh builder; no real target outcomes enter this pilot
Outer Agent access is procedurally restricted; only generator execution has explicit WSL/bubblewrap isolation
